lcc_original: 上帝說：『看哪，我將全地上結種子的各樣菜蔬、和各樣的樹、樹上有果實結種子的、都賜給你們做食物。
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): both = H0430 (Elohim); straightforward substitution
Word order of כָּל tokens differs: UNV puts 遍<WAH03605>地上 before 一切<WAH03605>菜蔬; LCC inverts to 全<WAH03605>地上…各樣<WAH03605>菜蔬 — SNs follow LCC word order
LCC restructures second object clause: 和各樣的樹、樹上有果實結種子的 vs. UNV 和一切樹上所結有核的果子; SNs distributed to nearest semantic equivalents
UNV所<WAH0834> (relative pronoun for אֲשֶׁר) mapped to LCC clause-final 的 (relative clause marker); slight uncertainty since 的 is multifunctional — main driver of confidence reduction
有核(UNV)→種子(LCC): both render Hebrew זָרַע (H02233); UNV 有核 = 'has kernel', LCC 種子 = 'seed', same referent
Second 樹 in 樹上 not annotated: following UNV precedent where עֵץ in פְרִי עֵץ was also not separately tagged
都(LCC) unannotated; corresponds stylistically to UNV全 in 全賜, but <WH05414><WTH8804> placed on main verb 賜 (נָתַתִּי)
{<WAH0834>} retained as implicit in same position as UNV (between accusative marker and first כָּל), matching FHL annotation convention
